stem.text: The diagrams show three different types of antibody structure.

stem.alt: Antibody structure drawing labelled IgG, Y-shaped with two binding arms.
Antibody structure drawing labelled IgA, with two binding arms on each side of a central pair of chains.
Antibody structure drawing labelled IgM, a star-shaped arrangement of five-armed chains radiating from a central point.

A.text: one binding site for an antigen molecule; two light chains; two heavy chains

B.text: two heavy chains; four binding sites for antigen molecules; five hinge regions

C.text: two hinge regions; four heavy chains; five light chains

D.text: two light chains; four hinge regions; ten binding sites for antigen molecules
